events.title: We're thrilled to be part of the Women-Led Games Showcase!
events.summary: Hi everyone! We are incredibly proud to announce that Dragon's Brew is featured in the Women-Led Games Showcase. As a two-person studio, we are thrilled to be part of such a fantastic lineup of games.We also wanted to let you know that we’ve updated the demo with fresh new graphics and customization options, just in case you want to check it out! You can find it on our Steam page.
